verdict: Yes. Beyond Snack from Thiruvananthapuram pitched Kerala banana chips on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Banana chips are loved across India, but most are sold loose and unbranded, so a brand with consistent quality, good packaging and new flavours stands out.
angle: Kerala's Nendran bananas and coconut oil give banana chips their distinctive taste. Buying directly from farmers and frying locally keeps costs low. Nitrogen-flushed packaging keeps chips crisp for months, which makes national distribution possible.
